author: Cosel, 1985

note.en: A small jackknife (razor) clam of about 2.5 cm, described from the Colombian coast and known here from a single specimen taken at 8 m off the Gandoca refuge station. It lives in a vertical burrow in sand and is not likely to be seen.
note.es: Una pequeña navaja de unos 2,5 cm, descrita en la costa colombiana y conocida aquí por un solo ejemplar tomado a 8 m frente al puesto del refugio de Gandoca. Vive en una madriguera vertical en la arena y es poco probable verla.

evidence: GBIF: 1 preserved specimen(s) in the region (INBio Atta collection, 2000), off the Gandoca refuge station
